heading:
Simple process.
Reliable result.
subtext: No long discovery phase, no mystery invoices. Here's how we go from call to live site.

steps.title: Intro Call
steps.body: A short call to cover your trades, service area, and what you want the site to do. No pitch, just listening.

steps.title: Content Handoff
steps.body: Send us your license info, headshot or crew photo, services, and pricing notes — as much or as little as you have on hand. We organize what you send and fill in the rest, so there's no builder to learn.

steps.title: Design & Build
steps.body: We build your site on our trade-business template system — brand-matched, mobile-first, and credible by design.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: You review a staging link. One round of revisions is included — we adjust wording, photos, and sections until it's right.

steps.title: Launch
steps.body: We point your domain, turn on SSL and analytics, register the site with Google and the AI answer engines — then it's live and findable everywhere.

steps.title: Hands-Off Ongoing
steps.body: Your site stays up and updated. Need a new service page or a service-area change? Send a note and we handle it.
